<thought>Using the ESI spectrum, the base peak at m/z 194.086 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting a proton gives a neutral mass of ≈193.079 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+2 ≈ 33 % of the base) is consistent with a single chlorine atom. Removing the mass of Cl (34.969 Da) leaves ≈158.110 Da for C, H, and O. The composition that best matches this residual mass is C₈H₁₄O₃, giving a total formula C₈H₁₄O₃Cl with a calculated monoisotopic mass of 193.063 Da, which is within typical experimental tolerance for the observed mass.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14O3Cl</final_answer>
